rehearsal: Option A — Control Plane sharing a server whose ports 80/443 belong to another product (coexistence overlay)
host: workstation (WSL Docker Engine), self-signed certificate; HTTPS port 9443 here because 8443 is the development gateway on this machine (the VPS default is 8443)

checksFromWindows.signInWithHttpsPortOrigin: 400 (reached the API; request validated, origin accepted)

certbotSidecar.renewal: certbot renew with DNS-01 manual hooks

dnsHookUnitTest: scratch test against a fake Hostinger API: PUT/GET/DELETE shapes, relative names for apex (_acme-challenge) and www (_acme-challenge.www), bearer header, zone left as found, wrong/missing token and foreign name refused without printing the token — ALL OK
notProvenHere: the real Hostinger DNS API call (needs the account's API token): proven on the VPS by `scripts/vps/cp.sh dns-test` before any certificate is requested
pioDeskImpact: none: separate Compose project, volumes, networks, database and ports; nothing of the other product read, written or restarted
